_comment: Every URL and path this skill points at. No placeholders: a null value means the resource is not released yet, and the skill says so in plain words instead of linking to an empty page.

desktop_app.note: The standalone Windows app is announced but not shipped. There is no installer to download yet, so this skill does not link to one. When it ships, the release page and a SHA256SUMS.txt go here and setup.ps1 starts verifying them.

install_commands.manual: Copy the skill folder into your OpenClaw skills directory, then run scripts/verify_install.py.
